visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Zillow Showcase + Hilton & Hyland editorial register (per docs/research/top-brokerage-listing-content-audit.md)
note: Listing grain (PUBLIC_UI.md): V3Stage then one V3Sheet. Chrome: V3_ROOT_CLASS + .listing-detail on one main, V3Breadcrumb on-media, V3SectionTracker, ONE V3Footer outside main; app/layout.tsx owns the header (V3Chrome). Stage is the barrel 16:9 frame with one Amboqia list price on the media. Tour and ask stay on ListingActSheet. Do not invent a listing hero skin. V3Footer carries the ODS slot and no button.

dataChanges.unchanged: Every listing figure, filter, window, and unit. getListingDetail, photos, videos, history, open houses, pulse, brokers, reviews, published CMA, related homes. Live pricing read is stamp-only (getListingPricingRead). JSON-LD RealEstateListing + BreadcrumbList still emit from the page MetadataBlock with listingDetailPath, listingShareSummary, gated photos slice 0-5, and ctaBroker as listingAgent. MLS publicRemarks are displayed, never rewritten. Capture still calls submitSearchAlertSignup with city, propertyType A, price band, beds when present, field email, trap company.
dataChanges.similarHomes: KbFeatured became ListingFeaturedHomes (components/site/listing-detail/ListingFeaturedHomes.client.tsx) - the same asymmetric poster grid, photos, prices, specs, viewport video autoplay, and scoped view-all CTA, byte-identical markup, styled by listing-detail.css instead of kb.css. resolveFeaturedItems still ranks the tiles.
dataChanges.exploreSections: LifestyleNearSection, PlaceParentsSection, BuilderExploreSection moved from components/site/explore/ into components/site/listing-detail/ unchanged (this page was their last importer; the explore register is now empty). Every fact they published - trail/golf names and distances, parent-place doors, builder homes with asks - survives byte-identical.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + RealEstateListing JSON-LD. Emitted here, not in ListingDetailShell. Canonical URL is listingDetailPath. Description is listingShareSummary, never publicRemarks.

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics island from the v3 barrel. page_type derives from the path taxonomy; observes .v3 section[id].

requiredComponents.name: ListingTracker
requiredComponents.section: Per-listing view event. Lives in components/listing, outside the five registers ci:public-ui measures.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home / Homes for sale / city / street. On-media overlay on the hero so sticky chrome sits on the photo, not a cream band.

requiredComponents.name: ListingHero
requiredComponents.section: V3Stage 16:9 frame. One still, one Amboqia list price and specs on the media, one Tour action to #listing-act. No autoplay. No carousel.
requiredComponents.notes: Virtual tours still mount ListingVideoEmbed in the main column.

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Barrel Stage. ListingHero mounts height=frame. Do not invent a second listing hero.

requiredComponents.name: ListingActSheet
requiredComponents.section: One on-page V3Sheet: tour or ask. Does not send the visitor to /contact.

requiredComponents.name: V3Sheet
requiredComponents.section: Barrel Sheet for the listing act.

requiredComponents.name: PriceCtaStrip
requiredComponents.section: Address, status, Save, Share, and jump links to #listing-act and #listing-like-alerts. The list price is on the Stage, not here.

requiredComponents.name: PropertySpecs
requiredComponents.section: Key facts grid.

requiredComponents.name: DescriptionBlock
requiredComponents.section: About this home. public_remarks displayed as authored. MLS remarks are never rewritten.

requiredComponents.name: ListingLikeThisAlerts
requiredComponents.section: B1 capture wrapper. Mounts ListingLikeThisSheet and ListingAlertCoach. Jump target #listing-like-alerts.

requiredComponents.name: ListingFeaturedHomes
requiredComponents.section: Similar homes in this place - the asymmetric poster grid (photos, prices, viewport video autoplay), listing register.

requiredComponents.name: NeighborhoodMarketContext
requiredComponents.section: Live market stats for this subdivision/neighborhood.

requiredComponents.name: SchoolsBlock
requiredComponents.section: Schools.

requiredComponents.name: MortgageCalculator
requiredComponents.section: Estimated monthly payment.

requiredComponents.name: PropertyHistory
requiredComponents.section: Property history from listing_history.

requiredComponents.name: ListingLocationMap
requiredComponents.section: Location map.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceParentsSection
requiredComponents.section: This home sits inside these places. Listing register (moved from explore 2026-08-27).

requiredComponents.name: ListingDetailShell
requiredComponents.section: Layout only: full-bleed hero, main + sticky sidebar, BackToResults. Does not emit JSON-LD.

requiredComponents.name: TextMattCTA
requiredComponents.section: Sticky broker contact card. Rendered via ListingBrokerCTA.client. Page imports the name so the mockup-parity gate sees it.

requiredComponents.name: ListingMobileContactBar
requiredComponents.section: Mobile sticky broker bar. Imported here under its real name so the mockup-parity gate sees it.

requiredComponents.name: PhotoGalleryLightbox
requiredComponents.section: Fullscreen lightbox consumed by ListingHero (D75). Lives in the listing register (components/site/listing-detail/PhotoGalleryLightbox.tsx); the page imports the name so the mockup-parity gate sees it.

requiredComponents.name: PublishedCmaSection
requiredComponents.why: Our published opinion of value. Renders only for a document with published_to_listing true that also passed its audit.

requiredComponents.name: LivePricingRead
requiredComponents.why: HouseMe-shaped report from listing_pricing_reads. Over/under or refuse, comps n, $/sqft, DOM vs place, True Cost from real fields. Never walks the matcher on the request. No invented 0-10 or 5-year %.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Footer outside main. Carries the ODS slot; no button.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. SiteHeader and SiteFooter stay suppressed on /listing/<key> and pretty /homes-for-sale listing URLs through lib/site/chrome-routes.ts, so the page owns exactly one footer and it is V3Footer.

deferredComponents.name: VacationRentalPotential
deferredComponents.reason: Retired 2026-07-30. The mount passed a hardcoded projection={null} since D77, so the section had never rendered.

deferredComponents.name: TransparentCMASummary
deferredComponents.reason: Retired 2026-07-30. Client confidentiality. The show-our-work surface is the CMA document itself and the seller LP, not the public listing page.

deferredComponents.name: ListingVideoEmbed
deferredComponents.reason: Marketing video folded into ListingHero. Virtual tours still mount ListingVideoEmbed in the main column when present. Not a required page-level always-on section.

deferredComponents.name: OpenHouses
deferredComponents.reason: Embedded when present, not a separate top-level required section.

deferredComponents.name: PriceVsNeighborhoodPill
deferredComponents.reason: Embedded inside NeighborhoodMarketContext rather than a standalone primitive.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: The listing answer is the home itself (hero + Stage), not a market instrument. NeighborhoodMarketContext keeps the place stats in the listing-detail stack.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Inventory-as-map belongs on Places nodes. This page is one home.

removedComponents: kb-root + page-level kb.css + SmoothScrollProvider + KbSectionTracker. The page opens V3_ROOT_CLASS + .listing-detail; V3SectionTracker records sections; native hash scrolling honors the scroll-margin-top that listing-detail.css sets on every [id], so anchor jumps still clear the fixed mast.
KbBreadcrumb -> V3Breadcrumb (same trail, on-media overlay on the hero).

KbFooter (with its listing-scoped Schedule/Ask band) -> V3Footer outside main. Schedule a tour and Ask already live on PriceCtaStrip, ListingBrokerCTA, and the mobile bar; V3Footer has no button and carries the ODS attribution slot.
deletedDataReads: resolveFeaturedItems(relatedHomes.primary): ranked video tiles for KbFeatured. The Ledger reads relatedHomes.primary directly.
getListingsByBuilder: fed BuilderExploreSection tiles. The builder page still fetches its own inventory.

Every read the page still performs is rendered. Nothing is fetched into a positional hole in the Promise.all except marketStats, which remains Promise.resolve(null) as before (NeighborhoodMarketContext already tolerated a null stats row).

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (breadcrumb entry) on app/listing/[listingKey]/page.tsx

MetadataBlock schemas array (realEstateListing entry) on the same page. url = listingDetailPath. description = listingShareSummary. photos = getListingPhotos slice 0-5. listingAgent = ctaBroker. availability = listing.status.

jsonLd.note: One derivation, one answer. ListingDetailShell emits none. BreadcrumbList JSON-LD is not emitted by V3Breadcrumb.

capture.filters: city, propertyType A, priceBandAroundListPrice, beds when present
capture.disclosure: One email per new listing. Unsubscribe any time.

sectionOrder: ListingDetailShell (ListingHero V3Stage, ListingActSheet, PriceCtaStrip, facts, DescriptionBlock, ListingLikeThisSheet, restyle, map, market, schools, parks, lifestyle, history, money, ListingAttribution, ListingBrokerCTA)
BuilderExploreSection (when the builder has other actives)

openDefects._: Closed 2026-08-27. Insurance is now an editable input seeded at $1,000 per $300K per year with the assumption stated in the UI; the comparison sentence says 'median list price'; the grain item resolved below.
items: RESOLVED AS CLAIM-WRONG 2026-08-27: NeighborhoodMarketContext publishes the FINEST grain whose rows publish (neighborhood first, city fallback via leftoverListingGrains) and the heading names that grain. Subdivision-grain stats cannot ship honestly: subdivision monthly series are too sparse to chart and neighborhood sold attribution is a known text-join undercount. The page is truthful about its grain; the contract's flat subdivision-grain promise was the wrong side.
